newsitem.title: USA: Summa Four CFO Thomas St. Germain retires.
newsitem.headline: Summa Four CFO Thomas St. Germain retires.

text.p: Summa Four Inc said Tuesday that Thomas St. Germain, its chief financial officer and senior vice president, will retire on June 30.
St. Germain joined Summa in 1993 as chief financial officer and guided the company through its initial public offering that year. Summa said he will remain in an advisory role to the company.
Summa, which provides switching platforms for the telecommunications industry, did not state its plans for a successor and was not immediately available for further comment.
